title: Show HN: Open Prompts – dataset of 10M Stable Diffusion generations
guide_zh: Open Prompts 公开千万级 Stable Diffusion 生成数据，用于研究提示词与图像。
author: vipermu
excerpt: Open Prompts is the dataset used to build krea.ai. The data comes from the Stability AI Discord and includes around 10M images from 2M prompts. You can use it for creating semantic search engines of prompts, training LLMs, fine-tuning image-to-text models like BLIP, or extracting insights from the data—like the most common combinations of modifiers.
